name: ui-designs
//typecheck: The package tsconfig emits declarations for the build, so a check has to pass --noEmit or it leaves a dist/ behind. The playground aliases the DS to source, so this compiles both workspaces against the same sources CI builds.
//lint: lint is eslint over the repo; lint:guard is the kit's own checks. The guards run by path from the root — they resolve their own sources, so they do not need the package as cwd.

scripts.typecheck: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/ledger/tsconfig.json --noEmit && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p playground/tsconfig.json --noEmit
